mapper.select: SELECT n.notice_id AS "noticeId", n.title, md.name AS "authorName", TO_CHAR(n.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "createdAt", n.view_count AS "viewCount" FROM notice n LEFT OUTER JOIN member_details md ON n.member_id = md.member_id WHERE n.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND n.notice_type = 'WORKSPACE' AND n.status = 1 AND n.deleted IS NULL ORDER BY n.created DESC, n.notice_id DESC
